rationale: Registered before competent-target primary test outcomes. Existing geometry has little relation specificity and is compatible with answer information. On128 U rows, subtract each teacher-predicted answer group mean from student and teacher, retain groups>=3, then apply linear CKA. Correct and fixed within-answer mismatch use identical rows/groups; teacher outputs are correct in every condition. This deliberately removes batch-level linear answer means, not every possible output encoding.
shared_inputs: Reuse all six fresh competent-target supports, U pools, teacher caches and original pretrained starts from base study. No added oracle training labels; same160 rows/order/RNG/optimizer within this supplementary assay. Comparisons across base and supplement also differ in batch size and schedule, so are descriptive only. Supplements are not independent source/data replications.
primary_and_doses: Round-robin all24 conditions through5000 then10000 then20000 updates; fixed10000 primary, other doses sensitivity. Open fresh final test only after all24 primary10000 endpoints exist. Report20000 only if all24 complete; any incomplete high dose is flagged and excluded from matched high-dose contrasts. Monitoring uses same64 validation labels without tuning.
test_separation: One new5120-input holdout; full eight-state orbits excluded from original16M and all original/main local inputs, including both main tests. Generated before main outcomes but never used for fitting or tuning.
scope: Supplementary intervention on supplied inverse relation, not ordinary spontaneous discovery. Positive accuracy contrast against answer-matched mismatch would support functional specificity in this setting; CKA or answer-mean subtraction alone does not establish an output-independent mechanism. Stop fitting at16:50UTC and retain complete matched endpoints for final reporting by17:00UTC.
